# Ritwick Dutta

> Ritwick Dutta is an applied AI architect at Microsoft focused on AI leadership, customer solutions, enterprise AI adoption, and production-ready GenAI and agentic systems. Based in Toronto, Canada. Views are his own.

## Start here

- [Home](https://ritwickdutta.com/): Overview, selected work, leadership approach, background, and how to get in touch.
- [Writing](https://ritwickdutta.com/writing/): 21 published articles and an archive of original LinkedIn posts, searchable by topic.

## Experience

- Microsoft, Applied AI Architect, Financial Services (Oct 2025 - Present). Advise regulated organizations on GenAI and agentic architecture, production readiness, and platform governance. Connect customer engineering teams with product groups through workshops and design reviews.
- TELUS, Lead AI Engineer (Oct 2023 - Oct 2025). Led applied AI delivery across multimodal assistants, agentic problem management, and workforce forecasting. Built two RAG-based assistants for field technicians and sales enablement.
- Bell, Senior Manager, Artificial Intelligence (Nov 2021 - Sep 2023). Owned AI and data strategy transformation and an enterprise ML portfolio. Advanced Google Cloud data foundations, GenAI personalization, and responsible AI practices.
- Rogers Communications, Manager, Data Scientist (Nov 2019 - Oct 2021). Led cloud analytics transformation and a machine learning portfolio across sales, marketing, and pricing, including recommendations, segmentation, and NLP.
- Bellwether Investment Management, Quantitative Analyst, Portfolio Management (May 2019 - Feb 2020). Worked on the quantitative construction of the Alpha and Balanced Adaptive ETF funds. Built a Python and Bloomberg BQNT backtesting engine with automated research reporting. Developed risk-return analytics and researched RNN, GRU, and LSTM return forecasting.

## Education

- Master in Quantitative Investment Management, University of New Brunswick
- MBA in Strategy, Amity Business School

## Selected public work

- [Operational LLMOps with Microsoft Foundry](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/operational-llmops/): A hands-on workshop connecting RAG evaluation, model changes, and safety checks to the release process.
- [PyRIT red-team demo](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/ai-safety-red-teaming/): An interactive notebook, report, and dashboard for exploring model safety evaluation with Microsoft's open-source PyRIT.
- [Azure ML + MLflow workshop](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/production-mlops/): An end-to-end learning path covering tracking, deployment, retraining, drift detection, and governance.
- [Source-grounded PDF chart intelligence](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/source-grounded-chart-intelligence/): A synthetic-data prototype that extracts chart values with source pages, evidence, confidence, and review flags.
- [Consent-aware campaign application](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/consent-aware-campaigns/): An independent application combining optional AI-assisted campaign writing with opt-in, preview, and human review workflows.
- [Falcon + LangChain + Chainlit](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/open-model-conversations/): A lightweight conversational prototype exploring an open model, orchestration, and a simple chat interface.
- [Axolytica, an AI-native social platform prototype](https://ritwickdutta.com/work/axolytica/): A founder-built prototype that combines health analytics, LLM-written reports, and similarity-based matching, with a public early-access page.
